text: The heights of a certain type of plant have a normal distribution. When the plants are grown without
fertilizer, the population mean and standard deviation are 24.0 cm and 4.8 cm respectively. A gardener
wishes to test, at the 2% significance level, whether Hiergro fertilizer will increase the mean height.
He treats 150 randomly chosen plants with Hiergro and finds that their mean height is 25.0 cm.
Assuming that the standard deviation of the heights of plants treated with Hiergro is still 4.8 cm, carry
out the test. [5]
